subject.title: fix: slow session node delays sidebar for a minute

question: Should this PR preserve background warming only after adding per-node single-flight protection, or may repeated polls intentionally start overlapping catalog invocations?
rationale: The eight-second response goal is validated, but whether duplicate long-running reads are acceptable on an already unhealthy node is an operational risk choice not settled by the focused tests.

options.title: Add single-flight protection
options.body: Reuse the active per-node catalog promise across subsequent compatible polls so background warming remains bounded.

options.title: Accept overlapping reads
options.body: Merge the current behavior with explicit owner acceptance that persistently slow hosts may run multiple concurrent catalog operations.

recommendation.title: Add single-flight protection
recommendation.body: Reuse the active per-node catalog promise across subsequent compatible polls so background warming remains bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is maintainer-routed and this contributor supplied the live fleet behavior and timeout design rationale.
